name: Shatter Scar Vale
summary: Fel fire still burns in Shatter Scar Vale, north of Bloodvenom Falls in central Felwood. The vale bears the marks of the infernals that struck northern Kalimdor during the Third War, and demons remain among the craters.

sections.title: Impact of the Infernals
sections.body:
During the Third War, the Burning Legion sent living siege engines against northern Kalimdor. Shatter Scar Vale bore the force of that assault. Demonic infernals fell from the sky, breaking through the ancient canopy and striking deep into the earth. Their blows shattered the ground and left blackened hollows that still smolder with unholy fire.

The Legion was broken at Mount Hyjal, but the infernals and lesser demons did not disperse. They remain entrenched in the scarred earth.

faq.q: Why is the ground covered in craters?
aliases: why is shatter scar vale cratered
faq.answer: The craters were made by infernals the Burning Legion sent against the forest during the Third War. These hulking constructs of fel stone fell from the sky and struck the ground, leaving scars that still smolder across the vale.

faq.q: What creatures roam Shatter Scar Vale?
faq.answer: Constructs and servants of the Burning Legion still roam the vale. Living infernals guard the smoldering impact basins, with lesser demons left behind when the invasion faltered.

faq.q: Where is Shatter Scar Vale located?
faq.answer: Shatter Scar Vale lies in central Felwood, directly north of Bloodvenom Falls along the eastern side of the forest's main path.

angles.text: The fel-infused cores of the infernals in these craters hold chaotic magic left by the Legion's invasion.
The smoldering scars in this vale remain open wounds in Kalimdor's spirit. They refuse to heal while the Legion's constructs still burn.
